stakes.purpose: The Reporting Persons believe that the Issuer's Common Stock is undervalued and represents an attractive investment opportunity. On October 26, 2026, Arkhouse Management (together with its affiliates, "Arkhouse") and Cobblers Cove Capital LP ("Cobblers Cove") delivered to the Board of Directors of the Issuer (the "Issuer's Board") a non-binding proposal (the "Proposal") to acquire all of the outstanding shares of Common Stock of the Issuer for $39.00 per share, in cash. A copy of the Proposal is filed herewith as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference. Also on October 26, 2026, Arkhouse and Cobblers Cove executed a non-binding summary of proposed terms (the "Term Sheet") outlining a framework for working together on an exclusive basis, subject among other things to finalization of terms and definitive documents, to pursue an acquisition of the Issuer, sharing certain fees and jointly bearing certain expenses related to such potential acquisition, and agreeing a structure for the post-acquisition governance and operation of the Issuer. The Term Sheet also provides a non-binding framework pursuant to which each of Arkhouse and Cobblers Cove would fund a committed percentage of equity financing required in connection with the acquisition. The above summary is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Term Sheet, a copy of which is filed herewith as Exhibit 99.2 and is incorporated herein by reference. The Reporting Person highlighted its prior engagement with the Board and intention to continue to work together in a constructive manner toward an outcome that is in the best interests of all shareholders and other stakeholders, and the Reporting Person's track record delivering substantial value at other portfolio companies. A copy of the Letter is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated herein by reference.

The Board was increased to eight directors at the initial closing. Voting restrictions: While Bubble owns at least 5%, it generally has discretion over voting or tendering shares representing up to 20% of the Issuer's common stock. Shares above that threshold must generally be voted or tendered proportionately with other shareholders. Additional proportional voting restrictions apply to director elections while Bubble maintains its board designation right. Standstill and transfer restrictions: While holding at least 5%, Bubble is subject to customary standstill provisions restricting additional acquisitions, takeover proposals, proxy solicitations and efforts to control the Issuer.
